HMAC Generator

Compute HMAC-SHA256 / SHA512 / SHA1 of any message with your key, in hex, base64, or base64url.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste the message.
  2. Enter the secret key and pick a hash algorithm.
  3. Click Generate — copy the HMAC in hex, base64, or base64url.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which crypto is used?

HMAC via the WebCrypto SubtleCrypto API — the same primitives browsers use for TLS.

Is my key sent anywhere?

No. The key and message never leave your browser tab.

Which hash algorithms are available?

Yes — HMAC-SHA1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 are all supported.

How is the key encoded?

Keys are UTF-8 encoded. For binary keys, convert them to text first.
